  > Implemented PSI-102. Server action createEventBoardAction(eventId) in src/features/calendar/actions.ts: requires kanban.write, returns existing board when boards.event_id matches (idempotent, DB also enforces via idx_boards_event), else inserts board named after the event with event_id/created_by, inserts default columns (Backlog/In Progress/Done, Done is_done), then copies ONLY group audience rows into board_groups (users/roles excluded per finance.md §1). getCalendarEventsAction now attaches board_id to each event via one batched boards lookup. calendar-view.tsx shows 'Open board' (router.push /dashboard/kanban?boardId=) when board_id set, else 'Create event board' for canCreateBoard holders (spinner + inline error); calendar/page.tsx passes canCreateBoard = session.permissions.includes('kanban.write'). getBoardAction now fetches the linked event (id,title,starts_at,ends_at,all_day) when event_id set; KanbanBoardData gained event_id/event; kanban-view-page.tsx reads ?boardId= from search params and shows a 'Linked event: <title> (<date>)' chip linking back to /dashboard/calendar; kanban/page.tsx wrapped in Suspense. Added 5 unit tests (event-board.test.ts): naming+event_id+columns, groups-only audience copy, second-click idempotency, permission denial, missing event.
